framework.prioritisation: ICE (Impact 1-10, Confidence 1-10, Ease 1-10, Score = (I + C + E) / 3)
rules: Test one major lever at a time (positioning, hero clarity, benefit-led CTA copy).
Do not A/B test critical crawlable SEO elements (H1, canonicals, robots, schema markup).
Assign variants client-side with zero layout shift and preserve variant across session in localStorage.
Track experiment assignment via 'experiment_assigned' event and include experiment_id and variant in all conversion events.
Require adequate sample size before declaring winners; label low-volume results as directional signals.

experiments.name: Homepage Hero CTA Benefit-First Copy
experiments.hypothesis: Changing the homepage hero primary CTA from generic 'Add to Chrome' to 'Try Rank Kiwi — Free' or 'Research Outliers Free' communicates immediate zero-friction value, increasing outbound webstore click-through rates.

treatment.label: Try Rank Kiwi — Free
treatment.ariaLabel: Try Rank Kiwi Free on the Chrome Web Store

experiments.name: Instagram Landing Page Intent-Matched Hero CTA
experiments.hypothesis: Visitors landing on /instagram-analytics/ are specifically seeking Instagram Reels and profile performance tools. Changing CTA copy to 'Research Instagram Outliers' will outperform generic copy by directly confirming search-intent match.

treatment.label: Research Instagram Outliers
treatment.ariaLabel: Install Rank Kiwi to Research Instagram Outliers

experiments.name: YouTube Landing Page Intent-Matched Hero CTA
experiments.hypothesis: Framing the primary action as 'Research YouTube Outliers' rather than generic installation will increase conversion from channel managers and creators seeking breakout Shorts/video ideas.

treatment.label: Research YouTube Outliers
treatment.ariaLabel: Install Rank Kiwi to Research YouTube Outliers

experiments.name: Comparison Pages Decision-Stage Value Proposition
experiments.hypothesis: Visitors reading comparison matrices are in an active evaluation state. Emphasizing 'Try Free Without Account' in the comparison decision CTA reduces perceived trial friction compared to standard copy.

treatment.label: Try Free — No Account Needed
treatment.ariaLabel: Try Rank Kiwi Free without an account on Chrome Web Store

experiments.name: Best-of Editorial Pages Contextual Decision Placement
experiments.hypothesis: Adding a lightweight contextual action block immediately following the evaluation criteria table (before the full tool reviews) allows high-intent visitors who already know their requirement to convert without scrolling past 6 lengthy reviews.

changelog.author: Bhavishya Singla

doNotTestAgain.concept: Aggressive modal popups upon page load
doNotTestAgain.reason: Destroys user trust, degrades Core Web Vitals (CLS/INP), causes search crawler penalties, and violates Rank Kiwi's privacy-first brand principle.

doNotTestAgain.concept: Fake countdown timers or artificial scarcity claims
doNotTestAgain.reason: Rank Kiwi is genuinely $0/mo free software; deceptive scarcity undermines credibility with creator and developer audiences.

doNotTestAgain.concept: A/B testing indexable H1s or canonical tags
doNotTestAgain.reason: Causes search engine crawler churn, duplicate title flags, and ranking instability across organic search queries.
